name: Leonteus
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the diameter JPL lists; not three measured axes.
credit: JPL Small-Body Database, physical parameters for 3793 Leonteus: diameter 112.046 ± 1.846 km; JPL's stated reference: urn:nasa:pds:neowise_diameters_albedos::2.0[jupiter_trojans] (http://adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...759...49G)
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 112.046 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists for Leonteus. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed color or terrain.
introduction: Leonteus was found at Palomar on 11 October 1985.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 112.046 km diameter JPL lists. Its shape and pole are not measured.
